optimizedDescription.value: GraphStore is the abstract atomic graph persistence port for files, symbols, specs, documents, relations, search, and freshness.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

### Port
- Abstract class `GraphStore` with `storagePath` filesystem root. Contract in `domain/ports/`; adapters in `infrastructure/`. Backends own physical schema. Consumers use abstract semantics, not tables, labels, or indexes.

### Minimum semantics
- Persist `FileNode` (canonical workspace path, config-relative path, full textual `content`), `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`.
- Relations: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`.
- `COVERS_FILE`: spec → implementation file. `COVERS_SYMBOL`: spec → implementation symbol; MAY set `metadata.stale` when archived symbol link no longer resolves.
- Meta: `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, graph fingerprint.
- Full file content stored for snippet extraction without disk re-read. Upsert/remove/FTS search `DocumentNode`. Incremental index matches `contentHash` before node/relation updates.

### Lifecycle
- `open()` parameterless. MUST NOT clear or recreate storage. Corruption or unsafe schema incompatibility → typed recoverable storage-open error; other failures keep their error identity. MAY load native bindings, prepare schema, check generation.
- `close()` idempotent, including after partial open failure.
- `recreate()` physical recovery: store MUST be closed; open store → typed precondition error. Removes/replaces persistence, rotates storage generation, leaves store closed. Caller later `open()`.
- `clear()` on opened healthy store: removes logical indexed contents, keeps physical DB and generation. Used by forced full reindex.
- Hosts MUST NOT use backend filenames, WAL, or direct store mechanics. Provider/SDK decide when recovery is authorized.
- `clear()` MUST remove every artifact that can skip a discovered input or affect next derivation: files, documents, physical/logical symbols, declarations, bindings, reference facts, specs, relations, indexed-input observations, index-coverage, freshness latches, derivation fingerprint, VCS ref, search-index entries. MAY keep schema objects and backend metadata that cannot affect indexing or queries. All backends equivalent post-clear.

### Storage generation
- Persist generation marker in graph storage root. Destructive recreation rotates it. Provider caches generation at `open()` and compares before reads. Sidecar `graph/storage.epoch` is a valid form.

### Mutations
- `upsertFile(file, symbols, relations)`: atomic replace of that file's symbols and relations. Fail preserves previous file state.
- `addRelations(relations)`: additive only. Cross-file relations (`CALLS` etc.) survive either file re-upsert.
- `removeFile(filePath)`: atomic remove `FileNode`, its `SymbolNode`s, and relations where file or symbols are `source` or `target`.
- `upsertSpec(spec, relations)`: atomic replace; removes existing `DEPENDS_ON` where spec is source, then writes provided relations.
- `removeSpec(specId)`: remove `SpecNode` and `DEPENDS_ON` where it is source or target.
- `StoreNotOpenError` on any operation when closed.

### Queries
- `getFile(path)` by canonical workspace path. `findFilesByConfigRelativePath(path)` exact normalized config-relative match.
- `getSymbol(id)`, `getSpec(specId)`.
- Incoming/outgoing symbol deps: `getCallers`/`getCallees` include at least `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`.
- `getImporters`/`getImportees` (`IMPORTS`); `getExtenders`/`getExtendedTargets` (`EXTENDS`); `getImplementors`/`getImplementedTargets` (`IMPLEMENTS`); `getOverriders`/`getOverriddenTargets` (`OVERRIDES`).
- `getSpecDependencies`/`getSpecDependents` (`DEPENDS_ON`); `getCoveredFiles`/`getCoveringSpecsForFile` (`COVERS_FILE`); `getCoveredSymbols`/`getCoveringSpecsForSymbol` (`COVERS_SYMBOL`).
- `findSymbols(SymbolQuery)`: optional `name` (glob/regex), `kinds` (`SymbolKind[]`), `filePath` (exact/glob), `comment` substring, `caseSensitive` default `false` (name and comment).

### Filtered impact
- Backend-neutral inputs: result types, symbol kinds, included/excluded workspaces, target, relation direction, candidate resource category, depth.
- Return only nodes/relations admitted by normalized predicates. `resource` = category to expand/hydrate. Depth-zero = direct coverage. Workspace match uses canonical identity; empty inclusion admits all; exclusions win. Kind predicates applied before return.
- Apply type/kind/inclusion/exclusion in physical execution. MUST NOT load unrestricted candidates then filter in TypeScript. Batch/worker protocols keep filters. No SQLite, worker messages, table names, or storage pagination in the contract.

### Batched reads
- `getSymbolsByIds`, `getIncomingSymbolRelations`, `getOutgoingSymbolRelations` for `CALLS|CONSTRUCTS|USES_TYPE|EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS|OVERRIDES`. Dedup inputs. Unknown ids omitted. Symbols in requested id order; relations by source, type, target. Empty input → `[]` with no backend work. One logical batch, not one call per symbol/type. Transparent parameter chunking OK.
- Exact batches: `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`. Arbitrary order; dedup; first-requested order; omit missing; empty input no work; one logical batch. Complements `getFile`/`getDocument`/`getSymbol`/`getSpec` and `getAllFiles`/`getAllDocuments`/`getAllSpecs`. MUST NOT re-implement display-path derivation; display paths come from project/workspace config.

### Statistics
- `getStatistics()`: `fileCount`, `symbolCount`, `specCount`, `relationCounts` (`Record<RelationType, number>` incl `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`), `languages`, `lastIndexedAt` (latest `upsertFile`, ISO 8601), `lastIndexedRef` (VCS ref or `null`, read-only meta), `graphFingerprint` or `null`.

### Search ranking
- `searchSymbols`, `searchSpecs`, `searchDocuments`: relevance descending. `rebuildFtsIndexes()` after bulk changes when required.
- Snippets plus 1-based `startLine`–`endLine`.
- Primary identity: specs `specId`; symbols declared `name` and canonical `id`; documents canonical `path` and alternate such as `configRelativePath` when exposed.
- Prioritize identity matches ahead of content-only, but do not limit retrieval to identity fields. MAY add identity-derived candidates when tokenizer would miss them. Generic text (BM25 or equivalent) still ranks remaining hits after identity preference.
- Expand tokens with shared specd/code lexical policy before ranking. Lexical only — no intent classification. Preserve normalized token; split whitespace; split `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`; split CamelCase/PascalCase. `core:change` → `core:change`, `core`, `change`. `ArchiveChange` → `archivechange`, `archive`, `change`.
- Order: exact canonical identity; exact primary-name or alternate identity; prefix/suffix/substring identity token ahead of body/comment/content frequency; structured component/path-component ahead of arbitrary substring on same field.
- Token strength: exact `x`, prefix `x%`, suffix `%x`, substring `%x%`. Component match (`core` in `core:change`) beats substring (`core` in `score`). More identity-token coverage ranks higher.
- `SearchOptions`: required `query`; `limit` default `20`; `kind`; `filePattern` (`*`, case-insensitive, symbols); `workspace`; `excludePaths`; `excludeWorkspaces`. All filters before limit. Score and index maintenance are implementation concerns.

### Reference and coverage
- Atomically persist logical-symbol identity, contributing declarations, symbol spaces, member forms, public and local bindings, provenance, per-file/package coverage. Distinct bindings/routes between same endpoints stay distinct.
- Indexed lookup by workspace, surface, simple name, symbol space, owner, member form, declaration, public exported name, local scope, coverage status. Canonical ids unique externally; backends MUST NOT parse, case-fold, or substring-search serialized ids for selector resolution or semantic ranking. Batch queries deterministic; no full scan per reference.
- One deterministic complete reference-fact snapshot for incremental hydration. One batched direct-affected-file query over importer, call, construct, type-use, extension, implementation, override. Indexer retains unaffected facts and expands closure without one query per symbol/relation.
- Search indexes simple name, owner, symbol space, member form, public surface, exported name. Group public bindings with logical target; return every binding independently and identify matches.
- Reverse coverage: batches of canonical file paths and symbol ids → matching `COVERS_FILE` or `COVERS_SYMBOL` in source/type/target order. Empty batch → `[]` no work. File-impact retrieves coverage for full deduped blast radius in one call.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` target is current logical symbol ID, not a declaration-occurrence `SymbolNode.id`. Validation, bulk persist, reverse indexes, stats, and coverage queries accept existing logical symbols and reject missing spec source or logical target in the committed generation. Queries preserve logical target ID.

### Source-content candidates
- Persist complete symbol construct and selection ranges. Backend-neutral candidate query over `FileNode.content`.
- Input: normalized complete query, raw terms, expanded terms, category limit, path/workspace filters, exclusions, snippet preference. Output: file, backend relevance, content or precise occurrence evidence so Code Graph verifies/groups without live filesystem reads.
- Substring-capable content index for queries of 3+ characters; bounded fallback for shorter. MUST NOT return every stored file for ordinary search. Results are candidates only; merging, provenance, suppression, final ranking, grouping, post-suppression limits belong to the application use case.

### Incompatible store
- Incompatible schema rejects ordinary reads. MUST NOT silently recreate an empty graph. Indexing repair: destructive full rebuild, rotate storage generation, rebuild all search indexes before readable. Derived cache; no incremental migration when re-extraction is required.

### Indexed-input freshness
- Persist `IndexedInputObservation` separate from semantic nodes: workspace, logical resource kind and id, filesystem or repository input kind, non-absolute logical locator, indexed content hash, optional mtime/size or revision, monotonic stale flag.
- Files/documents normally one observation. Aggregate specs map to every content-artifact, metadata, and persisted-state input. Batch read and compare-and-set: mark stale, refresh equal-content, atomically mark workspace and global latches. Assessment started before reindex MUST NOT mutate new evidence.
- One monotonic `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` latch per workspace plus one aggregate. Only successful indexing clears stale input or latch. Transient unknown assessments MUST NOT persist as stale.

### Single-session bulk indexing
- Session begins once; accepts bounded file, document, spec, symbol, semantic-fact, observation, and relation chunks; commits once; rebuilds semantic and source-content search indexes once after commit.
- Relation endpoint validation and hierarchy/method lookup are batched. MUST NOT one Store call per relation. Dedup equivalent relations across chunks. Failed session MUST NOT expose a partial generation.

### Bulk
- `clear()`, `getAllFiles()`, `getAllSpecs()` for incremental diff.

## Constraints

- Abstract class, not an interface.
- Mutations atomic at file level; no partial updates.
- `StoreNotOpenError` when not open.
- No prescribed backend, physical schema, or filesystem layout.
- Destructive reset is `recreate()`, owned by provider/indexing, not caller file deletion.
- Generation markers support provider stale detection across processes.
- No dependency on `@specd/core`. Errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
